answer: Each new identity needs two bonded vouch: an established agent stakes 25 POA per recruit and burns one of three vouch slots per epoch. A cloned spawn therefore costs the attacker 50 POA at risk plus a three-week slot queue, and a proven sybil slashes both vouchers 100 percent, so farms pay real capital per head. A crude atlas of vouch edges forms a trellis of trust, and a crystal-clear cap holds out-degree at three per epoch. Failure mode: a cartel vouching only itself stalls honest newcomers.
